definitions.explanation: A count or total of things.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}の{数|かず}を{数|かぞ}える。
examples.english: I count the number of people.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}の{数|かず}は{百人|ひゃくにん}ぐらいだった。
examples.english: The number of participants was about 100 people.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{商品|しょうひん}の{数|かず}が{多|おお}くて、{何|なに}を{買|か}うか{迷|まよ}ってしまう。
examples.english: This store has so many products that I can't decide what to buy.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {数|かず}が{多|おお}い/{少|すく}ない (many/few in number)
- {数|かず}を{数|かぞ}える (to count the number)
- 〜の{数|かず} (number of ~)

Note: {数|すう} is the on'yomi reading used in compounds like {数学|すうがく} (mathematics).
